teacher-services.description: I worked on two projects during my time at DfE.

hmrc-paye-account.description: The objective was to improve the PAYE tax account service so that users could better self-serve.

the-aa.description: The project’s objective was to replace a problematic sales journey and my account area with a faster, reliable and more user-centred service.

unilever.description: A key objective for Unilever was to reduce the cost and time-to-market for digital marketing campaigns.

merchant-portal.description: Network International are the largest merchant acquirer and payment solution provider in the Middle East and Africa.

money-claims-service.description: I joined the project during the alpha stage.

gender-pay-gap.description: I joined the project during the GDS alpha stage.

my-bt.description: The project’s objective was to enable existing BT customers to better self-serve within their account area.

agent-online-self-serve.description: The aim of the Agent Online Self-Serve (AOSS) was to improve the online services for tax agents and also to reduce the reliance on HMRC’s agent contact centre.

your-tax-account.description: The purpose for Your Tax Account (YTA) was to make the management and payment of taxes accessible to everybody, not just accountants.

trusted-trader.description: People are turning to sites like Check-a-trade and My Builder to find peer reviewed tradesmen in their area.

product-reviews.description: The TV reviews project was Which’s first step of their responsive site redesign & re-architecture program.

radio-times-ipad-app.description: This was Radio times’ first foray into the world of apps.

bq.description: I was involved with B&Q’s site redesign from the concept phase right through to production.

barclaycard.description: My principle project on the Barclaycard account was the redesign their customer account homepage.

tagcmd.description: Tag:CMD is a tool that agencies and their clients use to collaborate online on creative work in progress, from TV commercials to web banners and print pieces.

tapp-iphone-ipad-app.description: The TAPP approvals app for iPhone and iPad compliments the Tag:CMD web application by providing agencies with the ability to approve marketing work on the go.

android-iphone-apps.description: Following the release of the iPad app, Rightmove brought app development in-house.

property-details-page.description: The property details redesign was always going to be a challenging project as we needed to meet the needs of the buyer, vendor, estate agent and of course Rightmove itself.

ipad-app.description: The iPad app was Rightmove’s first venture into mobile apps.

draw-a-search.description: During a Rightmove hack-week our small team developed the idea of drawing property searches on a map.

homepage-redesign.description: My role at Lastminute.com was as a visual and front-end designer.
